column1: # Known-output expectations for the real-binary check (test/real_tools/check_real_tool.py, .github/workflows/real-tools.yml).
# min_plasmid_share: the least share of the input (a plasmid) that the tool must call plasmid. 0 means "recorded in the summary, not yet enforced":
# no real run had been reviewed when this file was written, so a floor would be a guess. After the first scheduled run, read its summary artifact
# and set the floor from the observed value (a little below it), in a reviewed commit. A tool that rewrites contig names or breaks its output
# format fails regardless of the floor.
